# Committed reference corpora

Small deterministic command streams for offline replay checks, generated by
`tools/diff_fuzz` (build target `diff_fuzz`). Each is plain ASCII, LF, one
command per line, exactly 500 requests. Replay with:

    ./build/test/diff_fuzz --replay testdata/corpora/<name>.txt

Exit code 0 means engine and reference model produced identical FillEvent
streams and identical book state after every request (plus invariant checks).

| File            | Seed | Op mix (a/c/m/x = Add/Cxl/Mod/Mkt) | Requests |
|-----------------|------|-------------------------------------|----------|
| mix-heavy.txt   | 100  | 50/20/20/10                         | 500      |
| cancel-heavy.txt| 101  | 30/50/15/5                          | 500      |
| market-heavy.txt| 102  | 35/15/10/40                         | 500      |

Other generator parameters for all three: price center 100000, price spread
1000, qty range [1, 1000], active band [20, 60], degenerate rate 2%, crossing
rate 25%.
